requirement: Research again looks only at what failed, is old or was never tried; each network's social search is a part of its own with a stricter, wider search

oracle.invariant: S1: run reasons failed, outdated, rule-changed, never with each part's ceiling; kept none, up-to-date, unavailable; the cap drops the dearest part as over-cap. S2: one letter off + full branch phone → confirmed with name_near; without proof → pending; two letters off → rejected; closed page → pending page_closed; the phone query runs second and finds the page. S3: facebook-search/instagram-search rows with the social-search rule version; Research again runs only the two searches (Google Place Details not fetched again) and leaves nothing due; nothing due queues nothing; a press during a queued run joins it. S4: only the Instagram search runs and the try's time is on the current research. S5: RESEARCH_AGAIN_LIMIT, then a run started_by account with its plan; stranger: queued with a receipt and a ceiling within one job's cap, the second press joins, then PUBLIC_AGAIN_LIMIT, then PUBLIC_RESEARCH_SPENT. S6: the place gains the Instagram link verified by the operator; the unknown url is PAGE_NOT_FOUND. S7: the field mask asks for formattedAddress, nationalPhoneNumber, internationalPhoneNumber and the facts keep them.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command
